_comment: Generated release artifact of The System — Nexus Patch Feed. The Notion Patch Feed is the source of truth; this file is its public read-only projection, regenerated by /broadcast on each patch and by the admin's nightly sync. Do not hand-edit. It is a sanctioned boundary mirror, not a fallback: a player's agent has no route into the admin Nexus, so this is the read path that always works — a plain HTTPS GET of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TechSecWhisperer/ars-infinita-notion/main/feed.json, no browser and no connector required. 'mechanics_version' is the current game-rules version and 'head' is the newest patch below; both names are used verbatim by the boot card and /doctor, which is why both fields exist even when they hold the same value.

patches.title: v1.0.0 — Gate Protocol goes live
patches.player_facing_summary: The System becomes multiplayer-distributable: the Seed, /awaken, /petition, /party, the Patch Feed itself, and the Sigil Check. Existing instances keep their history untouched; new features are usable from today.

patches.title: v1.0.1 — Codex copy: "Story Bank" naming unified
patches.player_facing_summary: Copy-only patch: the XP table line "Story added to Skill Inventory" now reads "Story added to Story Bank" everywhere, matching the database's display name. No XP values, rules, or schemas change.

patches.title: v1.0.2 — Maintenance window (schedule-setup fix incoming)
patches.player_facing_summary: The System is briefly in maintenance while we fix an issue with automated schedule setup during /awaken. Your data is untouched and commands work normally. If your daily briefing didn't switch on after you awakened, that's the known issue — a fix is coming and you'll be prompted to re-run /awaken. You may see a short maintenance note instead of an automated briefing during the window.

patches.title: v1.1.0 — Capability tiers: /vitals, /doctor, and graceful mobile-lite
patches.player_facing_summary: The System now checks what your session can actually do and adapts to it. New /vitals reports your setup's capabilities (desktop vs mobile-lite, whether an agent browser is available); new /doctor runs diagnostics and repairs common issues. On app-only or mobile sessions, commands that need a browser now degrade gracefully with a clear "won't run here" message instead of failing silently. /awaken now walks you through agent-browser setup so the full command set is available. No XP values, levels, or rules change.

patches.title: v1.2.0 — Alpha 2: The Gates Reopen
patches.player_facing_summary: Alpha 2 is here. Gatecrasher I now unlocks at 2 tracked applications — forward-only, so nothing you've already earned is re-locked. Levels 1–4 are now the Tutorial Arc, your onboarding stretch; once it closes you'll see a stated normal daily-XP band so progress reads clearly. New 📅 System Calendar: your daily briefings and reminders now appear as calendar entries you can browse later, not just one-off notifications. The schedule-setup fix shipped: /awaken now creates your Daily Quest Briefing scheduled task — existing players, re-run /awaken once to pick it up. And The System's plugin now installs from the public marketplace repo — one link. Your history and data are untouched.

patches.title: v1.3.0 — Follow-up, refocused (rules adopted; plugin build to follow)
patches.player_facing_summary: Rules change today; the plugin that implements them ships next. ADOPTED NOW: follow-up becomes stage-weighted — chasing an application nobody has answered rarely changes the outcome, so pre-contact quests (Saved, Applied) stop raising overdue flags, debuffs, streak consequences or any "you're late" framing, while post-contact quests (Recruiter Screen and beyond, where a human has replied) keep the tight cadence and become the priority surface. Also adopted: setup will ask which theme you want and refuse to proceed until you answer — no default, no silent fallback; and any number Notion can compute itself will be computed by Notion and read by your agent rather than re-derived, so your Player Card can't drift from your Ledger. NOT YET IN YOUR PLUGIN: until the next plugin build lands, your installed copy still runs the old flat two-day cadence and setup still has no theme question. You may still see follow-up prompts on quests nobody has answered — those are retired by rule, and you can ignore them. Forward-only: no past XP or streak is re-scored, and nothing is required from you. TRUE TODAY: The System is now MIT licensed — free to use, fork and modify.

patches.title: v1.3.1 — The build landed
patches.player_facing_summary: The two changes your v1.3.0 note listed as adopted as rule, not yet in your plugin — stage-weighted follow-up, and the theme question at setup — are now in the installed plugin. Update to receive them. Forward-only: nothing re-scored. (Supersedes the v1.3.0 line saying your copy still ran the flat cadence and had no theme question.)

patches.title: v1.3.8 — Copy corrections, and one version number
patches.player_facing_summary: Two wording corrections to the rule surfaces, no change to how anything scores. First: the rule saying The System never reveals odds now says plainly what your plugin already does — if you ask directly how the Forge works, its odds and its payout, you get a straight answer. That has been true in the shipped command since 31 July; the rule page just hadn't caught up. The System still won't volunteer anything about a roll you didn't win. Second: the XP table row for a development action now names your Competency Matrix, which is what the database is actually called in your workspace, instead of an internal name. The amount is unchanged at 30. Nothing is re-scored and there is nothing to do.

patches.title: v1.3.9 — Codex installer advisory, and a clearer description
patches.player_facing_summary: If you installed The System for the Codex CLI before v1.3.6, check your own skills. Versions up to 1.3.5 installed 27 skills into the shared skills folder and replaced anything already sitting under the same name — so a skill you wrote yourself called status, log, report, browse, doctor or patch may have been overwritten without warning. Nothing in your Notion workspace is affected; this only touched files on your own machine. The installer now refuses to overwrite anything it did not install, and will tell you the exact paths instead. Antigravity installs were never affected. This notice is late because the channel that delivers it compares a version number that four releases had not moved; that is fixed, and this is the first release that could carry it.

patches.title: v1.3.10 — Build your CV the way you want it read
patches.player_facing_summary: Your CV builder now works the way you would expect to be able to ask it. /armor assembles your CV from named sections, so you can rearrange it in plain language — "move my skills above experience", "drop the interests section", "put certifications at the top". Layout presets cover different situations (graduate, career change, technical, academic, and cleared or government roles), and switching between them reorders your sections without changing a word of what they say. /armor now also adapts to where the job is rather than where you are. Resume convention genuinely differs by country, and getting it wrong costs you in both directions: two pages is right in the UK and over-long in the US, a photo is conventional in Germany and can get an application discarded in Australia or the US, and some European employers expect a data-processing consent line. /armor reads the target country from the quest and applies that market's conventions for length, spelling, dates, personal details, referees and work rights — then tells you in one line what it changed, so you can overrule it. Nothing is invented on your behalf: adapting to a market changes how your history is presented, never the facts in it. NOT YET IN YOUR INSTALLED COPY: this note is published with the release that carries the code, so until your client offers you an update, your /armor still behaves the old way. Update when the offer appears. Forward-only — no XP value, level threshold, badge criterion or unlock rule changed, and nothing you have already earned is re-scored.
